Little Chef: Prototype

Download Now

Play the new Demo now!

You can get Little Chef: Cozy Cooking on Steam right now!

If you want to be a part of the development, you can see our progress on YouTube or TikTok where we post almost daily.

If you want to be notified via e-mail when the game releases, you can sign up here: Mailing List

Thank you <3

___

Little Chef is a fun and cute 2D physics-based cooking game with a focus on experimentation and discovery.

ALL sprites that have been created for this game can be downloaded for free and used for your own projects (link to the assets).

Enjoy!

PS: If you want to reset all of your progress press "R" + "Enter"
